bullets: The backlog fell for the first time since the migration.
427 in against 431 resolved, so open went 698 → 657. The closed bar finally sits level with the open stack — but it took a quieter inflow week to do it, not more throughput.
The ageing got worse while the total got better.

31–90 days went 192 → 256 and 8–30 days fell 327 → 247: the middle band is draining straight into the old one. 271 cases are now past 30 days against 204 a week ago, and the median open ticket is 26 days old, up from 20.
The 90+ tail is holding, just.
15 against 12 last week and 73 at the start of August. The oldest work is still being cleared, but three cases crossed the line this week.
